text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Thursday.
- Croatian Democratic Union's (HDZ) call for cooperation with the parties of the center is not just a part of the pre-election campaign, says the president's internal policy adviser, Ivic Pasalic.

- Croatian Bank for Reconstruction and Development (HBOR) is not lowering its interest rates, as it does not want to represent competition to commercial banks, says in an interview HBOR's president, Anton Kovacev.
- A midday car mafia shoot-out in Zagreb leaves one dead.
- A third of the Serbs from Eastern Slavonia will leave Croatia, says in an interveiw the Serbian Democratic Forum general secretary, Veljko Dzakula. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
